result.question: What do groups not serving on Sabbath do?

readings.answer: Guard the house of the LORD for the king.
readings.support: would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king
those going off duty—and came to Jehoiada the priest

assessments.reason: Verse 11:7 states the two divisions going off duty on the Sabbath "are to guard the house of the LORD for the king," which matches the key "Guard Yahweh's house."

Verse 11:9 says those going off duty, along with those coming on duty, "came to Jehoiada the priest," so it is a plausible answer to what they did, though it differs from the key’s focus on their assigned guard duty.

result.reason: The text supports both that the off‑duty groups guard the LORD’s house (v.7) and that they came to Jehoiada (v.9), so more than one materially different answer fits the question.
